searchText: I hear you, the reason I voted 1 is that 5pm is already too late for me 🙂 5am would be more or less fine. Reviewed the mev-boost code and getting excited to try it with prysm on the interop setup. One minor feedback, i dont think mev-boost currently handle `rpcError` but that's not a low hang fruit. Happy to open an issue
